src.meaning: decoded image source, or array of path candidates (first that decodes wins). ONE wide render shown in a LANDSCAPE 16:9 frame with object-fit:cover (wide crop matches the source wide cover)

wordmark.meaning: ghost baked serif wordmark across the TOP of the cover; scales WITH the cover

captionLines.meaning: lower-left caption lines (children of the cover, scale with it)

issueLine.meaning: small issue line under the captions

coverWidthVw.meaning: assembled (rest) cover WIDTH — wide, near full viewport; height follows aspect-ratio

scatter.meaning: tile scatter as a fraction of the cover (radial from center; OUTER tiles get a longer reach so the centre seats first)

restTileAlpha.meaning: rest tile opacity; source chips are NEAR-INVISIBLE

restScale.meaning: tile rest scale before it flies home and seats to 1

assembleEnd.meaning: timeline progress where the cover is fully assembled; the rest is the modest grow

growPeak.meaning: MODEST uniform transform:scale at peak (full-bleed wide cover, crops top/bottom). DO NOT over-scale (no 6x); capped <=1.5

ease.meaning: the ONE project ease (cubic-bezier 0.25,0.74,0.22,0.99); drives assembly AND the grow; falls back to power3.out
